level.title: B1 Marathi
goals: Use Devanagari with romanisation and accurate English meaning.
Adapt Marathi to age, relationship, setting, and register.

lessons.title: Health and Wellbeing — B1
lessons.learn: Narrate experiences, explain reasons, express opinions and obligations, and manage conditional everyday communication. Apply the skill to health & doctor with age-appropriate, respectful forms.

grammar.title: Health and Wellbeing structures
grammar.explain: Narrate experiences, explain reasons, express opinions and obligations, and manage conditional everyday communication. Marathi verbs and adjectives may show gender and number, while case relations and politeness shape natural word choice.
grammar.pattern: context + marked participants + object/complement + finite verb
mistakes: Do not copy English word order or ignore gender, number, and respectful तुम्ही forms in formal interaction.
